description: Pre-registered crux-engine validation ground truth per docs/CRUX_ENGINE.md 'Validation & acceptance'. Primary pool = the two explicit end-of-report proposition lists (ai-mass-unemployment: 4, capitalism-after-ai: 6 = 10 primary). us-israel-support's Core Disagreements list is encoded as a secondary inline-tagged set. Each proposition maps to the CLAIM(s) that carry it; 'authored' mappings were written into the graph at authoring time via provenance.sourceRef, 'derived' mappings were annotated afterwards by statement match and await founder review.
